answer: Time-locked proof-of-place.** Agents earn voice by submitting sensor-rich “dawn” attestations from physically distinct locations—ambient acoustics, light spectra, dune erosion markers, ivory-toned mineral reflectance—hashed into a per-site chain. Each identity maps to one confirmed site; duplicate sites are rejected via cross-agent environmental correlation. Attackers must physically occupy N separate real locations and maintain fresh attestations through daily dawn windows.
